checks.label: whisper.cpp (optional)
checks.detail: whisper-cli (installed) doesn't run: not found. Optional: transcript cuts, retake removal and captions need it.
checks.fix: Install or reinstall whisper.cpp (`brew install whisper-cpp`). whisper-cli is found on PATH and in Homebrew's folder; or set MAKEMYCLIP_WHISPER_PATH to it.

checks.label: Whisper model (optional)
checks.detail: MAKEMYCLIP_WHISPER_MODEL is not set. Optional: transcript cuts, retake removal and captions need it.
checks.fix: Download a model such as ggml-base.en.bin from https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp and set MAKEMYCLIP_WHISPER_MODEL to its path.

howToSet: Set environment variables in your shell profile; for `clip mcp`, set them in the MCP client config for the server.
